systems.country_label: WAPIS Senegal; CREDIPOL (Data and Police Information Collection and Registration Centre), the DACORE, with its automated police information database
systems.platform: WAPIS, INTERPOL programme funded by the European Union
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior: CREDIPOL created by decree 2021-1213 of 29 September 2021, headed by a National Police superintendent appointed by decree 2022-78 of 12 January 2022, staffed by seconded police officers and gendarmes; programme run by INTERPOL
systems.tiers: the national data centre in Dakar (head office at SICAP Foire), inaugurated 17 May 2022; no station or brigade named as entering data

systems.owner: INTERPOL National Central Bureau, Senegal, and CREDIPOL, under an interconnectivity agreement signed 8 April 2022
INTERPOL and CIVIPOL, European Union funding of EUR 15 million, launched 1 March 2022
systems.tiers: all ECOWAS members and Mauritania; three pilot countries not yet named

note: WAPIS in Senegal is classed identification on the CREDIPOL head's description: it gives investigators the criminal record of an accused person and locates wanted persons, weapons and vehicles, and holds crime statistics. The newsletter places it at the Dakar data centre only (inaugurated 17 May 2022) and says extension beyond the DACOREs is the programme's next phase; it does not say stations or brigades enter reports or cases, so no record fact.
